planets.name: TOI-5795 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-5795 with a 6.14-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-5795 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-5795. Its orbit and size follow Manni et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
